description: Project registration index for the Personal Agentic Workbench.
registration_rules: Project registration must not automatically grant access to repositories or external services.

Each project must have its own configuration file describing repository URL, purpose, technologies, directories, instructions, testing requirements, deployment restrictions, security considerations, and reporting requirements.
No credentials or sensitive environment variables may be stored in project configuration files.
Project registration is descriptive only; it does not confer write access.
All writes to registered projects require explicit human approval.
